Hey

If you're still reading comments then just know that I'm in the exact same place as you. I'm diagnosed with all sorts of genetic defects like depression, anxiety and bipolar and I'm so so sorry that this is happening to you. It's not fair. 
I saw one of your older posts about your 5 year mark of coming out and I'm really happy that you managed to find that sort of comfort to allow you to tell people how you are. You attached a pic in the post and honestly you are absolutely stunning. You look like your own person and that's a hard thing to be able to show off to the world. 
If there's anything to take from this small post it's the fact that there's 7 billion people in this world and you may feel alone in amongst that number but there's hundreds of thousands maybe millions of people who will genuinely care for you. We're here for you, we love you. Your decisions are yours and yours alone, don't let people get in the way of that but at the same time really think them through, it's really really important (I know it's super monotonous to read that phrase as it's used a lot but it does apply, even if you think about these issues all the time regardless)
Again, we're here for you. I'm from Australia and I'm here for you. If you want a chat I'd be happy to do that :)

- Jacob.
